name: Xinference built-in rerank model catalogue
notes: Xinference built-in rerank model list. Includes bge-reranker-base/large, bge-reranker-v2-m3, bge-reranker-v2-gemma, jina-reranker-v2/v3/m0, Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B/4B/8B, Qwen3-VL-Reranker, MiniCPM and R3-rerank - a much wider reranker set than TEI documents, and one that includes decoder-only and multimodal rerankers.
